data.name: Atuf
data.gender_notes: Atuf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is given favor or blessing. The name Atuf carries the meaning “Favor” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Atuf usually hope their child will grow to embody favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Atuf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atuf total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_english.name: Atuf
in_english.meaning: Good water, clean water, good, pure, and virtuous
in_english.long_meaning: Atuf is an Arabic name that means good water, clean water, good, pure and virtuous. It is used in the Quran in Surah Al-Muminoon in verse 26. The name Atuf has an Arabic root from the root ع-ت-ف. It is a healthy name and recommended for naming children due to its positive impact on personality, reputation, and health. The name Atuf has its roots in the Arabic language and is used in many Muslim cultures. It is a popular name among Muslims due to its meaning and significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Atuf" holds cultural significance for those of Arab and Islamic descent. In the Arabic language, Atuf is derived from the root "T-F-T," which commonly signifies "giving" or "granting." In an Islamic cultural context, a person named Atuf may be seen as someone who has been favored or blessed with good fortune, good health, or other worldly blessings. This can translate into societal admiration and respect, as well as a sense of personal pride and gratitude.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Atuf" carries deeper meaning as it is derived from the same Arabic root as the Arabic word "tawfiq," which means "success" or "granting of a wish" from God. The name can evoke feelings of inner peace and contentment, as one remembers that all blessings ultimately come from the divine. Atuf may be seen as a reminder to remain humble and grateful in the face of God's blessings, and to offer thanks and praise to God regularly. In this way, the name "Atuf" can serve as a reminder of the spiritual connection to the Divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Favor" symbolizes One who is given favor or blessing. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Atuf serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of favor.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Atuf ibn Qais al-Asadi was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and one of the Ten Promised Paradise. He participated in several major battles, including the Battle of Uhud and the Battle of Hunayn. He was also known for his generosity and his deep understanding of Islamic law.
historical_references.time_period: 624-632 AD (1st year of Prophethood to the 8th year of Hijrah)

historical_references.reference: Atuf al-Bakri was an Andalusian explorer and geographer who lived during the 12th century. He is best known for his work 'Al-Masudfi al-Absar fi Akhbar al-Bashar' (The Useful Topography), which is considered one of the most important sources for the history of the Maghreb and West Africa during the Middle Ages.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Atuf' is derived from the Arabic language, meaning 'solid' or 'firm'. This name holds significance in Islamic culture and calligraphy, where it represents stability, strength, and endurance. In the modern context, Atuf is gaining popularity as a trend in Islamic calligraphy, Arabic typography, and art and design. On social media platforms like Instagram and Pinterest, users share images of Atuf calligraphy artwork, typography designs, and home decor items with this name. These platforms provide a vast space for artists to showcase their creativity and connect with a global audience. On Redbubble, a popular online marketplace, you can find a wide range of Atuf-themed products such as prints, phone cases, and wall art, demonstrating its growing popularity in the art and design world.
